The '''Aeten system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]] and its primary [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Aeten (star)|Aeten]].
